'''Love''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[spice lord]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Love and a fellow spicelord [[Joy (spicelord)|Joy]] accompanied the information broker [[Krata]] during his exchange of information with the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Vette]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
